Name: Marriott International Inc
Description: Marriott International, Inc. (MAR) is a leading global hospitality company based in Bethesda, Maryland, renowned for its extensive portfolio of lodging brands that cater to diverse market segments, including luxury, premium, and select-service hotels, as well as residential and timeshare properties. With a strong presence in more than 130 countries and territories, Marriott operates and franchises over 7,000 properties under well-known brands such as Marriott Hotels, Ritz-Carlton, and Sheraton. The company is committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences and maintaining a focus on sustainability and community engagement, positioning itself for continued growth in the dynamic hospitality sector. As a key player in the travel industry, Marriott leverages its scale and loyalty programs to drive customer retention and enhance profitability.
Address: 7750 WISCONSIN AVENUE, BETHESDA, MD, UNITED STATES, 20814
